# Menus and redirects

The site's menus and their items, and the redirects the server answers before any page. Read `navigation` and `redirects` first.

[`menu.create`](#menucreate) · [`menu.rename`](#menurename) · [`menu.delete`](#menudelete) · [`menuItem.add`](#menuitemadd) · [`menuItem.remove`](#menuitemremove) · [`menuItem.move`](#menuitemmove) · [`menuItem.update`](#menuitemupdate) · [`redirect.add`](#redirectadd) · [`redirect.update`](#redirectupdate) · [`redirect.remove`](#redirectremove)

## menu.create

Add a menu: its key (what a header, a footer or a page names to show it), its name in the editor and, optionally, its first items and its place among the menus. Refused with `menu.exists` (the key is taken), `menu.target` (an item leads to a page the site lacks), `menu.pageTwice` (one page linked twice), `menu.nesting` (a column title on a top-level item) and `menu.invalid` (too many items, an item id twice).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "menu", "navigation".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes | The new menu's key: lower-case words joined by `-` (`footer-legal`); what a header, footer or page names to show it. |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 80) | yes | The menu's name in the editor; visitors never read it. |
| `items` | ({ id: string, label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)>, target: { kind: "page", pageId: string (min 1, max 36) } \| { kind: "anchor", pageId: string (min 1, max 36), anchor: string } \| { kind: "external", href: string (max 2048) \| Record<string, …> } \| { kind: "languages" }, children?: (… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) |  | Its first items, in order. |
| `position` | integer ≥0 ≤10000 |  | Its place among the site's menus; absent: last. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"footer-legal","label":"Note legali","items":[{"id":"lg1pr1v0","label":"Privacy","target":{"kind":"page","pageId":"df63a5d6-46ef-4c5e-ade1-c130ad76c2b8"}},{"id":"lg2c00k1","label":{"it":"Cookie","en":"Cookies"},"target":{"kind":"page","pageId":"935b8383-32ab-485b-ad6f-989ed59ceb9b"}}]}
```

## menu.rename

Change a menu's name in the editor; its key, what pages and layouts name, stays. Refused with `menu.unknown`.

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| `label` | string (min 1, max 80) | yes | The menu's name in the editor; visitors never read it. |

## menu.delete

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes | A menu of the site: its key (`main`, `footer`), as the `navigation` read lists the menus. |

Example input:

## menuItem.add

Add one item to a menu: at the top level, or under a top-level item (`parent`), at `index` (absent: last). Refused with `menu.pageTwice` (the menu already links that page), `menu.target` (no such page), `menu.nesting` (an item with children under a parent, a column title at the top level, no such parent), `menu.invalid` (an id the menu holds, too many items) and `menu.unknown`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "menu", "navigation", "link".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | string (max 40) | yes | A menu of the site: its key (`main`, `footer`), as the `navigation` read lists the menus. |
| `item` | object | yes | A menu item: `id` (8 characters of [0-9a-z], unique in the menu), `label` (words, or language → words) and `target`: a page (`{ kind: "page", pageId }`), a named place on a page (`{ kind: "anchor", pageId, anchor }`), an outside or site address (`{ kind: "external", href }`: https://, mailto:, tel: or /path) or the language switch (`{ kind: "languages" }`). A top-level item may hold `children` (one level); a child may hold `group`, the column title of a wide menu. |
| `item` › `id` | string | yes |  |
| `item` › `label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> | yes |  |
| `item` › `target` | { kind: "page", pageId: string (min 1, max 36) } \| { kind: "anchor", pageId: string (min 1, max 36), anchor: string } \| { kind: "external", href: string (max 2048) \| Record<string, string (max 2048)> } \| { kind: "languages" } | yes |  |
| `item` › `children` | ({ id: string, label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)>, target: { kind: "page", pageId: string (min 1, max 36) } \| { kind: "anchor", pageId: string (min 1, max 36), anchor: string } \| { kind: "external", href: string (max 2048) \| Record<string, …> } \| { kind: "languages" }, group?: stri… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) |  |  |
| `item` › `group` | string (min 1, max 40) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 40)> |  |  |
| `parent` | string \| null |  | The top-level item to put it under; null or absent: the top level. |
| `index` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place among the items there (0 first); absent: last. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"menu":"footer","item":{"id":"f9st0d10","label":"Lo studio","target":{"kind":"page","pageId":"5dc75cd8-babd-4fc7-a6cd-bd8a9fd77068"}}}
```
```json
{"menu":"footer","parent":"f3la6v0r","index":0,"item":{"id":"f3vg1u11","label":"Via Giulia","target":{"kind":"page","pageId":"51c8bffb-cbdb-4746-afad-319dbc96382d"},"group":"Restauro"}}
```

## menuItem.move

Move a menu item to another place: the top level, or under a top-level item (`parent`), at `index` (absent: last); the items under it move with it. Refused with `menu.nesting` (an item with children under another, an item under itself, a column title at the top level), `menu.unknownItem` and `menu.unknown`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "menu", "navigation", "reorder".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | string (max 40) | yes | A menu of the site: its key (`main`, `footer`), as the `navigation` read lists the menus. |
| `id` | string | yes | A menu item's id: 8 characters of [0-9a-z], unique in its menu (the `navigation` read lists them). |
| `parent` | string \| null |  | The top-level item to put it under; null or absent: the top level. |
| `index` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place among the items there (0 first); absent: last. |

Example input:

```json
{"menu":"footer","id":"f5se7v1z","parent":null,"index":0}
```

## menuItem.update

Change a menu item's words, where it leads or its column title (null clears the title); a field left out is kept. Refused with `menu.pageTwice` (the menu already links the new page), `menu.target` (no such page), `menu.nesting` (a column title on a top-level item), `menu.unknownItem` and `menu.unknown`.

- **op**; class `pages` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "menu", "navigation", "link".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | string (max 40) | yes | A menu of the site: its key (`main`, `footer`), as the `navigation` read lists the menus. |
| `id` | string | yes | A menu item's id: 8 characters of [0-9a-z], unique in its menu (the `navigation` read lists them). |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 120)> |  | Its words, or language → words. |
| `target` | { kind: "page", pageId: string (min 1, max 36) } \| { kind: "anchor", pageId: string (min 1, max 36), anchor: string } \| { kind: "external", href: string (max 2048) \| Record<string, string (max 2048)> } \| { kind: "languages" } |  | Where it leads, whole: `{ kind: "page", pageId }`, `{ kind: "anchor", pageId, anchor }`, `{ kind: "external", href }` or `{ kind: "languages" }`. |
| `group` | string (min 1, max 40) \| Record<string, string (min 1, max 40)> \| null |  | A child's column title in a wide menu; null clears it. A top-level item takes none. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"menu":"footer","id":"f2pe7s0n","label":{"it":"Persone","en":"People"}}
```
```json
{"menu":"footer","id":"f1pr0c3s","target":{"kind":"anchor","pageId":"87c82653-80cd-4b17-ae54-aca941cbf8a2","anchor":"processi"}}
```

## redirect.add

Add a redirect to the site's list: from a path of the site, or a path and everything under it, to a path of the site or an https address, with status 301 or 302. The server answers a redirect before any page. Refused with `redirect.duplicate` (that source has a rule already, a trailing slash ignored), `redirect.loop` (the chain leads back to one of its sources), `redirect.hidesPage` (the source is the address of a published page) and `redirect.invalid` (the list is full, or a rule is malformed).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "redirect".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `redirect` | object | yes | A redirect: `from`, a path of the site starting with / (end it with /* for the path and everything under it), `to`, a path of the site or an https:// address, and `status`, 301 (moved for good) or 302 (for now). |
| `redirect` › `from` | string (max 2048) | yes |  |
| `redirect` › `to` | string (max 2048) | yes |  |
| `redirect` › `status` | 301 \| 302 | yes |  |
| `index` | integer ≥0 |  | Its place in the list (0 first); absent: last. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"redirect":{"from":"/progetti/*","to":"/lavori","status":301}}
```
```json
{"redirect":{"from":"/studio-vecchio","to":"/cosa-facciamo","status":301},"index":0}
```

## redirect.update

Change the redirect from source `from`: its source, target or status, the rule given whole as `redirect`. Refused with `redirect.unknown` (no rule from that source) and the checks redirect.add makes (`redirect.duplicate`, `redirect.loop`, `redirect.hidesPage`, `redirect.invalid`).

- **op**; class `settings` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "redirect".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string (max 2048) | yes | The source of the redirect to change, as the `redirects` read lists them (a trailing slash is ignored). |
| `redirect` | object | yes | A redirect: `from`, a path of the site starting with / (end it with /* for the path and everything under it), `to`, a path of the site or an https:// address, and `status`, 301 (moved for good) or 302 (for now). Given whole. |
| `redirect` › `from` | string (max 2048) | yes |  |
| `redirect` › `to` | string (max 2048) | yes |  |
| `redirect` › `status` | 301 \| 302 | yes |  |

Example input:

```json
{"from":"/progetti/*","redirect":{"from":"/progetti/*","to":"/lavori","status":302}}
```
